## Overview

PE diagnostic panel using [`sstruth`](https://github.com/laurieKell/sstruth):

1. `ssCurve()` — equilibrium curves and time series
2. Kobe phase plots
3. Production function (yield vs SSB)
4. Yield vs SSB trajectories on the production function
5. Surplus production vs SSB — **`sprod`** (SS3 / r4ss yield4) and **`sp_ssb`** (SSB-based)
6. Process-error (PE) diagnostics — `pe_mode`: `log`, `relative` \((y-x)/x\), or `diff` \((y-x)\)
7. Four-panel PE residuals (time, vs SSB, ACF, histogram)

```{r, eval=FALSE  config}
library(FLCore)
library(kobe)
library(ggplotFL)
library(sstruth)
library(diags)

```

## i) Read objects with `ssCurve()`

```{r  load}
runs=ssRuns("P:/rfmo/iccat/2026/shark/Analysis/ss3")
pfs =ssCurve(runs)
pfs$curve=ddply(merge(pfs$curve,pfs$refpts),.(run),
                    transform,
                    stock  =ssb/bmsy,
                    harvest=(yield/ssb)/(max(yield)/bmsy))

parts         =strsplit(pfs$curve$run, "/", fixed = TRUE)
pfs$curve$scenario   =vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 1)
pfs$curve$sensitivity=vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 2)

pfs$curve$sensitivity=sub("^Sc1_", "",pfs$curve$sensitivity)
pfs$curve$sensitivity=sub("^Scn02_", "",pfs$curve$sensitivity)
pfs$curve$sensitivity=sub("^Sc3_", "",pfs$curve$sensitivity)
pfs$curve$sensitivity=tolower(pfs$curve$sensitivity)
pfs$curve$sensitivity=sub("initf_",  "initf",pfs$curve$sensitivity)


kb  =ssKobe(runs)

parts         =strsplit(kb$run, "/", fixed = TRUE)
kb$scenario   =vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 1)
kb$sensitivity=vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 2)

kb$sensitivity=sub("^Sc1_", "",kb$sensitivity)
kb$sensitivity=sub("^Scn02_", "",kb$sensitivity)
kb$sensitivity=sub("^Sc3_", "",kb$sensitivity)
kb$sensitivity=sub("initf_", "initf",kb$sensitivity)

kb$sensitivity=tolower(kb$sensitivity)
```

## ii) Kobe phase plots

```{r, eval=FALSE  kobe, fig.cap = "Kobe phase plot by scenario (equilibrium F/FMSY vs B/BMSY)}
kobePhase(kb)+
     geom_path(aes(stock,harvest))+
     geom_line(aes(stock,harvest),data=pfs$curve, col="blue")+
     facet_grid(scenario~sensitivity)
```

## iii) Production functions

```{r, eval=FALSE  production, fig.cap = "Equilibrium production function by scenario (single panel, colour = scenario)."}

ggplot(pfs$curve)+
     geom_line(aes(ssb,yield))+
     facet_grid(scenario~sensitivity)
```

```{r, pFuncs, eval=!FALSE, fig.height=6 ,fig.width=9}
b40=ddply(pfs$curve, .(scenario,sensitivity), with, {dif=abs(ssb-max(ssb)*0.4)
                               data.frame(ssb  =max(ssb)*0.4,
                                          yield=yield[order(dif)][1])})
b40=rbind.fill(b40[,-4],b40,b40[,-3])
b40$ssb[  is.na(b40$ssb)]  =Inf
b40$yield[is.na(b40$yield)]=0

b40  =b40
rfs  =pfs$refpts
crv  =pfs$curve
trngl=pfs$triangle
p=ggplot(rfs)+
  facet_grid(sensitivity~scenario,
     scale="free",space="free")+
  #geom_polygon(data=trngl,aes(x, y),                    fill="orange",  alpha=0.5)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin=0,    xmax=bmsy,ymin=msy,ymax=Inf),fill="#D55E00", alpha=0.3)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin=bmsy, xmax=Inf, ymin=0,  ymax=msy),fill="#009E73", alpha=0.3)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin=0,    xmax=bmsy,ymin=0,  ymax=msy),fill="#F0E442", alpha=0.3)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin=bmsy, xmax=Inf, ymin=msy,ymax=Inf),fill="#F0E442", alpha=0.3)+
  scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::comma)+
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma)+
  # Lines
  geom_line(data=crv, aes(ssb, yield), color="blue")+
  geom_abline(data=rfs, aes(slope=msy/bmsy, intercept=0), col="grey10", linetype=3) +
  # Reference points
  geom_point(aes(x=bmsy, y=msy), shape=21, fill="white", size=3)+
  geom_text( aes(x=bmsy, y=msy,  label="MSY"), hjust=-0.2, vjust=-0.2)+
  geom_path(aes(ssb,yield),col="green",data=b40)+
  #scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::comma,breaks=seq(0, 100000,by=20000),
  #                   expand=expansion(mult=c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("blue", "black"),
                    labels= c("Start", "End"),
                    name ="Time Period") +
  labs(title="Production Function",
       x    =expression("Total Biomass (t)"),
       y    =expression("Production (t)"))+
  theme_minimal(base_size=16) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
      strip.background=element_rect(fill="grey95"),
      strip.text=element_text(face="bold"),
      axis.title=element_text(face="bold"),
      plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold"),
      legend.position="bottom",
      axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1, size =10,margin=margin(t=10)),
      panel.grid.major.x=element_line(color="grey90"), 
      axis.line=element_line(color="black"))+
   coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,4e3),ylim=c(0,1.5e3), expand=FALSE)
p
```

## iv) Yield vs SSB trajectories

```{r, eval=FALSE  trajectory, fig.cap = "Observed yield vs SSB on the equilibrium curve."}
p_traj <- plotSsCurveYieldTrajectory(
  pe,
  run_col = run_col,
  title = "Yield vs SSB trajectory — SMA 2026 base scenarios"
)
print(p_traj)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-yield-trajectory.png"),
  p_traj, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 200
)
```

## v) Surplus production vs SSB

Two empirical series are in `pe$tseries`:

- **`sprod`**: $\mathrm{Bio\_all}_{t+1} - \mathrm{Bio\_all}_t + C_t$ (matches `r4ss::SSplotYield()` / `yield4_surplus_production.png` y-axis, plotted vs SSB)
- **`sp_ssb`**: $\mathrm{SSB}_{t+1} - \mathrm{SSB}_t + C_t$

```{r, eval=FALSE  sp-cols}
sp_cols <- intersect(
  c("year", "bio_all", "ssb", "yield", "sprod", "sp_ssb"),
  names(pe$tseries)
)
knitr::kable(head(pe$tseries[sp_cols], 6), digits = 1)
```

### SS3 total-biomass SP (yield4)

```{r, eval=FALSE  sp-ss3, fig.cap = "SS3 total-biomass surplus production vs SSB (sprod)."}
p_sp_ss3 <- plotSsCurveSpSsb(
  pe,
  run_col = facet_col,
  sp_col = "sprod",
  colour_label = "Scenario",
  show_production = TRUE,
  title = "SS3 total-biomass SP vs SSB — SMA 2026 base scenarios"
)
print(p_sp_ss3)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-sp-ss3.png"),
  p_sp_ss3, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 200
)
```

### SSB-based SP

```{r, eval=FALSE  sp-ssb, fig.cap = "SSB-based surplus production vs SSB (sp_ssb)."}

print(p_sp)
```

## vi) Process-error diagnostics

Relative scale default: `r pe_mode` (`log`, `relative` = \((y-x)/x\), or `diff` = \(y-x\)).

```{r, eval=FALSE  pe-diag, fig.cap = "Process-error diagnostics by scenario (SS equilibrium vs PT fit)."}
pe_panels <- lapply(stocks, function(st) {
  one <- list(
    tseries = pe$tseries[pe$tseries[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    curve = pe$curve[pe$curve[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    refpts = pe$refpts[pe$refpts[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  st_label <- label_map[[st]] %||% st
  diag <- plotSsPeDiagnostic(one, shapePt = 0.5, pe_mode = pe_mode)
  if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
    patchwork::wrap_plots(
      diag$ssb + ggplot2::labs(subtitle = st_label),
      diag$pe,
      ncol = 2,
      widths = c(1.2, 1)
    )
  } else {
    diag
  }
})

if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_pe <- patchwork::wrap_plots(pe_panels, ncol = 1)
  print(p_pe)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-pe-diagnostics.png"),
    p_pe, width = 11, height = 12, dpi = 200
  )
} else {
  pe_panels
}
```

### Diagnostic table

```{r, eval=FALSE  pe-table}
tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stocks, function(st) {
  one <- list(
    tseries = pe$tseries[pe$tseries[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    curve = pe$curve[pe$curve[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE],
    refpts = pe$refpts[pe$refpts[[run_col]] == st, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  d <- ssPeDiagnose(one, shapePt = 0.5)
  data.frame(
    scenario = st,
    label = label_map[[st]] %||% st,
    curve_cor = d$curve_cor,
    curve_rel_rmse = d$curve_rel_rmse,
    pe_cor_ssb = d$pe_cor_ssb,
    likely_misspecified = d$likely_misspecified,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
knitr::kable(tab, digits = 3)
utils::write.csv(tab, file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-pe-diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## vii) Four-panel process-error residuals

```{r, eval=FALSE  pe-four, fig.cap = "Four-panel process-error diagnostics (all scenarios)."}
p_four <- plotSsPeFourPanel(pe, pe_mode = pe_mode)
if (!is.null(p_four$panel)) {
  print(p_four$panel)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    file.path(fig_dir, "ss-curve-pe-four-panel.png"),
    p_four$panel,
    width = 10,
    height = 12,
    dpi = 200
  )
}
```

Alternative scales:

```bash
DIAG_PE_MODE=relative Rscript appendices/R/run-curve-diagnostics.R --appendix-dir appendices
DIAG_PE_MODE=diff     Rscript appendices/R/run-curve-diagnostics.R --appendix-dir appendices
DIAG_PE_MODE=log      Rscript appendices/R/run-curve-diagnostics.R --appendix-dir appendices
```
